title: Fetching in parallel and stopping on the first failure

concepts.description: errgroup.WithContext cancels the shared context when any goroutine returns an error, and Wait returns that first error.
concepts.context: FetchAll in fetch.go uses errgroup.WithContext so one failed fetch cancels the other requests

concepts.description: SetLimit caps how many goroutines run at once, so a long list does not open an unbounded number of connections.
concepts.context: g.SetLimit(4) in FetchAll limits the fetch to four requests in flight

concepts.description: A closure captures the loop variable itself, not its value, so goroutines started in a loop need their own copy (before Go 1.22).
concepts.context: FetchAll shadows i and url inside the loop before the g.Go closure uses them

concepts.description: Passing the context into the request lets cancellation stop an in-flight HTTP call rather than only the code around it.
concepts.context: http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, ...) ties each request in fetch.go to the errgroup's context
